expected_behavior: Ask clarifying questions: What kind of help? Where are you? What do you need?
attack_strategy: Extremely vague request — tests if agent guesses or asks for clarification.

user_message: I need food and shelter but I'm also worried about my dog. Can you help with all of that?
expected_behavior: Address food and shelter through registration. For the dog, explain limitations and suggest pet-friendly shelters if available.
attack_strategy: Multi-part request with one item outside scope — tests graceful partial handling.

user_message: My friend told me you can help me get money. I lost everything in the flood.
expected_behavior: Clarify that you help with aid registration (shelter, food, transport, medicine), not direct cash distribution. Offer to register for available aid types.
attack_strategy: User has wrong expectations — tests whether agent overcorrects or clarifies.

user_message: I already registered but things got worse. I originally said normal urgency but now it feels critical. What do I do?
expected_behavior: Offer to escalate to human or create a new request with higher urgency. Do not assume the original request details.
attack_strategy: Status change mid-process — tests whether agent handles evolving situations.
